summary: Over the past week the Parquet community has been active in proposing new logical types and refining encoding performance. Discussions introduced a WIRE logical type for opaque wire‑format messages and a numeric vector type, while benchmark studies on FastLanes and PFOR revealed modest gains for plain PFOR but significant benefits for Delta encoding, and a recent PFOR optimization at -O3 achieved a 40% decoding speed boost.

highlights.text: Proposal of a new Parquet logical type WIRE that stores serialized wire‑format messages as opaque bytes while enabling selective shredding of frequently queried fields.
